title: MBESO2D: An open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material BESO
description: An open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization for two-dimensional problems, with retained-solid regions, line loads and self-weight. The repository contains compact solvers, teaching comments, an equation-to-code map, numerical records, editable manuscript figure and table generators, and verification experiments for sensitivity and material-assignment histories. The documentation states the scope and limitations of the numerical comparisons.
